study: Monthly mean 2 m air temperature in Frankfurt am Main, 1981 to 2025: trend, seasonality and 36-month forecast skill

tables.name: frankfurt_t2m_monthly
tables.series: NASA POWER monthly T2M at lat 50.11, lon 8.68, 1981–2025
tables.role: target series: monthly mean air temperature at 2 m, Frankfurt am Main grid cell
tables.load_command: e2er-data nasa_power point --lat 50.11 --lon 8.68 --parameters T2M --temporal monthly --community RE --start 1981 --end 2025 --save-to frankfurt_t2m_monthly.csv --table frankfurt_t2m_monthly

api.service: NASA POWER (Prediction Of Worldwide Energy Resources), monthly point API
api.note: The monthly API is requested by whole years and runs to the previous year, so the latest complete month available on 2026-10-13 is 2025-12. The API version, data sources (MERRA-2) and access date are recorded by the loader in data_sources.json.

columns.name: date
columns.description: Monthly time index (ISO year-month). Unique, sorted, no gaps expected: 45 years x 12 = 540 months, 1981-01 to 2025-12.

columns.name: month
columns.description: Calendar month 1 to 12. Any month-13 (annual mean) row POWER returns is not part of the monthly series and is excluded in cleaning.

columns.name: T2M
columns.description: Monthly mean air temperature at 2 m, MERRA-2 grid-cell estimate (0.5 deg lat x 0.625 deg lon), not a station measurement.

tables.fill_value_handling: POWER's fill value -999 is stored as an empty cell (NULL), never as -999. Cleaning verifies that no T2M value equals -999 and reports the count of missing months. Missing months are not imputed in the raw table; if any occur, the analyst reports them and the forecast designer decides on handling before the freeze.

derived_fields.note: Derived by the data analyst in a cleaning script into a separate table (frankfurt_t2m_clean). The raw table is never overwritten. No estimation is done at this step.

fields.name: T2M
fields.definition: raw monthly mean, -999 set to NULL

fields.name: clim_1981_2010
fields.definition: arithmetic mean of T2M for each calendar month over 1981-01 to 2010-12 (30 values per month); 12 values, repeated for every year. The window lies wholly inside the training period, so it does not use hold-out information.

fields.name: anomaly
fields.definition: T2M minus clim_1981_2010 of the same calendar month

split.rule: The hold-out is the last 36 months of the series (3 full seasonal cycles, equal to the 36-month forecast horizon of the research question). It is fixed by the series length and horizon in advance, not by model performance. All diagnostics, decompositions, model selection and climatology are computed on the training periods only; the final forecast beyond the data uses a model refitted on all 540 months and is not evaluated on the hold-out. Final dates are confirmed against the actual last month in data.db and frozen by the forecast_design check.

units.trend: degrees Celsius per decade (reported by the analysis step)

caveats: POWER values are modelled MERRA-2 grid-cell means, not station records; they smooth urban heat island effects and local extremes. The paper must say so and may compare with a station series only if one becomes available (NOAA CDO is not available in this study).
POWER revises data with new versions; the load records the API version and access date.
The Frankfurt grid cell is one cell; spatial representativeness is not examined.
